summary: Produced tasks-lens-b.md defining the partition and dispatch shape for control-room-serve. Decomposed the work into two sequential units (additive ledger queries in Unit 1 and serve handlers/CLI in Unit 2), verified path disjointness and wave self-containment against the integrate gate, and recommended a single packet without an apply-dag.yaml sidecar.

hard_stops.hard_stop: No partition exists in which every wave is green on its own, so the change cannot be dispatched as waves at all. Say so; a single packet is the correct answer and is not a failure.
Two units that must run in the same wave cannot have disjoint allowed_paths because they edit the same file.
The design's file-changes table does not determine which unit owns a file.
Satisfying one instruction in this packet would require violating another.
